description: The large image view: opens over the whole window (what's behind dimmed almost to black), flying out of the image clicked and back into it when closed. A bar at the top names the image and offers Copy, Show in folder, Open (and Open in browser); ← / → step through every image in the chat; it zooms and pans smoothly. Also the right-click menu every image in the chat has.
opens: Click any image in the chat (a tool card's, a markdown image, an attachment thumbnail)
A picture on the side panel's Files page

parts.name: image menu
parts.shows: Right-click on any image in the chat: a menu at the pointer, no arrow: "View", "Open in browser" (web images only), "Copy image", "Open with default app", "Open in folder". Every image's tooltip: "<path or name>\nClick to view · right-click for more"; the pointer over it is a magnifier.

actions.does: Copies the image (the original file's, if it's a better copy than what the chat has) to the clipboard; toast "Image copied".
Opens the file (or a cached copy of the image) in the system's default app.
Shows the file in the file manager.

parts.name: backdrop
parts.shows: The window under it dimmed to 94% dark; all text in the viewer is white (secondary text white at 70%).

parts.name: top bar
parts.shows: As tall as a header bar (16px in at left, 12px at right): the title (bold heading, middle-ellipsized, filling the width), then the info line dimmed, then text buttons "Copy", "Show in folder", "Open", "Open in browser" (only for a web image), then a round ✕ button.

parts.name: title
parts.shows: The file's name, else the image's alt text or URL, else "Image".

parts.name: info
parts.shows: Parts joined by "  ·  ": "<width>×<height> · <size>" ("1280×720 · 34 kB", "2.1 MB"), then "<n> / <count>" when there's more than one image, then the zoom "<percent>%" while zoomed in.

parts.name: buttons
parts.shows: Copy (tooltip "Copy image"), Show in folder ("Open its folder"), Open ("Open with the default app"), Open in browser ("Open the original in the browser"), ✕ ("Close (Esc)").

parts.name: stage
parts.shows: The image centred in the rest of the window (56px margin each side, 8px top, 40px bottom), fitted to it: an image 400px or larger fills the space; a smaller one is shown at its own size, not blown up. Shown at once, then swapped for the original file's sharper copy if there is one, without moving.

actions.does: Closes the viewer (flies back into the image in the chat).
Zooms to 2× around that point, or back to fitted.
Zooms in/out (×1.25 a notch) around the pointer.
Pans while zoomed in; zooms when not zoomed, or with Ctrl/⌘ held.

parts.name: arrows
parts.shows: Round on-screen-display buttons (44px) at the left and right edges, vertically centred, 10px in: previous / next. Only when there's more than one image and it isn't zoomed in.

actions.does: Steps to the previous / next image, wrapping round; each shows fitted.

parts.name: keys
parts.shows: Keyboard while the viewer is open.

actions.does: Previous / next image (when not zoomed); pans a fifth of the view when zoomed.

parts.name: strip
parts.shows: Only when opened from a folder (the Files page's pictures): a row of 56px thumbnails centred along the bottom, the one shown highlighted (white at 85%), others lit on hover; scrolls sideways.

states.name: opening / closing
states.shows: The image flies (240ms) from where it sits in the chat to its place in the viewer, and back on close, while the backdrop dims or clears and the bar and arrows fade.

states.name: sequence
states.shows: The images stepped through are every image in the conversation (tool results, markdown images, attachments), in chat order.

states.name: zoomed
states.shows: Smooth zoom (160ms) up to 8 screen pixels per image pixel (sharp pixels when far in); the arrows hide; the info shows the percentage; the pointer is a grab hand.

states.name: can't be shown
states.shows: A folder's picture with no decoder here: info says "Can't be shown here: Open opens it in its app".
